label: FEMA Disaster Declarations → TAK
info:
Tennessee counties under an ongoing FEMA declaration from the last 365 days, drawn as county outlines: major disaster red, emergency orange, fire management yellow.

Data: OpenFEMA and Census TIGERweb (https://www.fema.gov/about/openfema/data-sets). Updates every 6 hours.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/fema-disaster-declarations
